info.brief: Command queue helpers for interacting with the Rive runtime
info.description: Command queue helpers for interacting with the Rive runtime

elements.name: rive.cmd.instantiateArtboardNamed
elements.description: Returns the artboard handle created for the named artboard.

parameters.name: file_handle
parameters.doc: Handle to a previously loaded Rive file.

parameters.name: artboard_name
parameters.doc: Name of the artboard to instantiate.

elements.name: rive.cmd.instantiateDefaultArtboard
elements.description: Returns the default artboard handle for the file.

parameters.name: file_handle
parameters.doc: Handle to a previously loaded Rive file.

elements.name: rive.cmd.deleteArtboard
elements.description: Deletes an instantiated artboard.

parameters.name: artboard_handle
parameters.doc: Handle to the artboard that should be removed.

elements.name: rive.cmd.instantiateStateMachineNamed
elements.description: Creates a named state machine for the provided artboard.

parameters.name: artboard_handle
parameters.doc: Artboard where the state machine resides.

parameters.name: name
parameters.doc: Name to assign to the new state machine.

elements.name: rive.cmd.instantiateDefaultStateMachine
elements.description: Creates the default state machine for an artboard.

parameters.name: artboard_handle
parameters.doc: Artboard used as the source for the state machine.

elements.name: rive.cmd.advanceStateMachine
elements.description: Advances the state machine by the requested delta time.

parameters.name: delta
parameters.doc: Time in seconds to advance the state machine.

elements.name: rive.cmd.bindViewModelInstance
elements.description: Binds the state machine to the provided view model instance.

elements.name: rive.cmd.deleteStateMachine
elements.description: Deletes a created state machine.

parameters.name: state_machine_handle
parameters.doc: Handle to the state machine to delete.

elements.name: rive.cmd.instantiateBlankViewModelInstance
elements.description: Returns a blank view model instance handle for the given artboard or view model.

parameters.name: file_handle
parameters.doc: Handle to a previously loaded Rive file.

parameters.name: artboard_or_viewmodel
parameters.doc: Artboard handle or view model name that identifies where to instantiate.

elements.name: rive.cmd.instantiateDefaultViewModelInstance
elements.description: Returns a default-populated view model instance handle for the given artboard or view model.

parameters.name: file_handle
parameters.doc: Handle to a previously loaded Rive file.

parameters.name: artboard_or_viewmodel
parameters.doc: Artboard handle or view model name the instance should derive from.

elements.name: rive.cmd.instantiateViewModelInstanceNamed
elements.description: Creates a named view model instance and returns its handle.

parameters.name: file_handle
parameters.doc: Handle to a previously loaded Rive file.

parameters.name: artboard_or_viewmodel
parameters.doc: Artboard handle or view model name that will host the instance.

parameters.name: instance_name
parameters.doc: Name to assign to the new view model instance.

elements.name: rive.cmd.referenceNestedViewModelInstance
elements.description: Returns a handle to the nested view model at the given path.

parameters.name: path
parameters.doc: Dot-delimited path to the nested view model.

elements.name: rive.cmd.referenceListViewModelInstance
elements.description: Returns the handle for the list entry at the specified path and index.

parameters.name: path
parameters.doc: Dot-delimited path to the list view model.

parameters.name: index
parameters.doc: Index within the list entry to reference.

elements.name: rive.cmd.setViewModelInstanceNestedViewModel
elements.description: Replaces the nested view model at the given path with the supplied handle.

parameters.name: view_model_handle
parameters.doc: View model instance whose nested child is updated.

parameters.name: path
parameters.doc: Path to the nested view model.

parameters.name: nested_handle
parameters.doc: Handle of the nested view model to attach.

elements.name: rive.cmd.insertViewModelInstanceListViewModel
elements.description: Inserts a nested view model into the list at the given index.

parameters.name: view_model_handle
parameters.doc: View model instance owning the list.

parameters.name: nested_handle
parameters.doc: Handle of the view model to insert.

elements.name: rive.cmd.appendViewModelInstanceListViewModel
elements.description: Appends a nested view model to the list at the specified path.

parameters.name: view_model_handle
parameters.doc: View model instance owning the list.

parameters.name: nested_handle
parameters.doc: Handle of the view model to append.

elements.name: rive.cmd.swapViewModelInstanceListValues
elements.description: Swaps two entries in the nested list.

parameters.name: view_model_handle
parameters.doc: View model instance that owns the list.

elements.name: rive.cmd.removeViewModelInstanceListViewModelIndex
elements.description: Removes the entry at the supplied index from the nested list.

parameters.name: view_model_handle
parameters.doc: View model instance owning the list.

parameters.name: index
parameters.doc: Index of the entry to remove.

elements.name: rive.cmd.removeViewModelInstanceListViewModel
elements.description: Removes the specified nested view model from the list at the path.

parameters.name: view_model_handle
parameters.doc: View model instance owning the list.

parameters.name: nested_handle
parameters.doc: Handle of the view model to remove.

elements.name: rive.cmd.deleteViewModelInstance
elements.description: Deletes the view model instance handle.

elements.name: rive.cmd.fireViewModelTrigger
elements.description: Fires a trigger on the view model instance.

elements.name: rive.cmd.setViewModelInstanceBool
elements.description: Updates the boolean property at the path.

elements.name: rive.cmd.setViewModelInstanceNumber
elements.description: Updates the numeric property at the path.

elements.name: rive.cmd.setViewModelInstanceColor
elements.description: Updates the color property using the supplied vector.

parameters.name: vector4_color
parameters.doc: Color encoded as a Defold Vector4 (WXYZ).

elements.name: rive.cmd.setViewModelInstanceEnum
elements.description: Updates the enum property at the path.

elements.name: rive.cmd.setViewModelInstanceString
elements.description: Updates the string property at the path.

elements.name: rive.cmd.setViewModelInstanceImage
elements.description: Updates the image property at the path.

elements.name: rive.cmd.setViewModelInstanceArtboard
elements.description: Updates the artboard reference at the path.

elements.name: rive.cmd.getViewModelInstanceBool
elements.description: Returns the cached boolean property at the path.

elements.name: rive.cmd.getViewModelInstanceNumber
elements.description: Returns the cached numeric property at the path.

elements.name: rive.cmd.getViewModelInstanceColor
elements.description: Returns the cached color property at the path.

elements.name: rive.cmd.getViewModelInstanceEnum
elements.description: Returns the cached enum property at the path.

elements.name: rive.cmd.getViewModelInstanceString
elements.description: Returns the cached string property at the path.

elements.name: rive.cmd.getViewModelInstanceListSize
elements.description: Returns the cached list size for the path.

elements.name: rive.cmd.subscribeToViewModelProperty
elements.description: Subscribes for updates to the named property.

parameters.name: path
parameters.doc: Path to the property to subscribe.

elements.name: rive.cmd.unsubscribeToViewModelProperty
elements.description: Cancels a previous subscription.

elements.name: rive.cmd.loadFile
elements.description: Loads Rive bytes and returns a file handle.

elements.name: rive.cmd.deleteFile
elements.description: Deletes the runtime file handle.

elements.name: rive.cmd.decodeImage
elements.description: Decodes image bytes and returns a render image handle.

elements.name: rive.cmd.deleteImage
elements.description: Deletes the render image handle.

elements.name: rive.cmd.decodeAudio
elements.description: Decodes audio bytes and returns an audio source handle.

elements.name: rive.cmd.deleteAudio
elements.description: Deletes the audio source handle.

elements.name: rive.cmd.decodeFont
elements.description: Decodes font bytes and returns a font handle.

elements.name: rive.cmd.deleteFont
elements.description: Deletes the font handle.

elements.name: rive.cmd.addGlobalImageAsset
elements.description: Registers a global image asset.

parameters.name: asset_name
parameters.doc: Name used to reference the global asset.

elements.name: rive.cmd.removeGlobalImageAsset
elements.description: Unregisters the named global image asset.

parameters.name: asset_name
parameters.doc: Name of the asset to remove.

elements.name: rive.cmd.addGlobalAudioAsset
elements.description: Registers a global audio asset.

parameters.name: asset_name
parameters.doc: Name used to reference the global audio.

elements.name: rive.cmd.removeGlobalAudioAsset
elements.description: Unregisters the named global audio asset.

parameters.name: asset_name
parameters.doc: Name of the audio asset to remove.

elements.name: rive.cmd.addGlobalFontAsset
elements.description: Registers a global font asset.

parameters.name: asset_name
parameters.doc: Name used to reference the global font.

elements.name: rive.cmd.removeGlobalFontAsset
elements.description: Unregisters the named global font asset.

parameters.name: asset_name
parameters.doc: Name of the font asset to remove.

elements.name: rive.cmd.requestViewModelNames
elements.description: Requests view model names for the file.

parameters.name: file_handle
parameters.doc: File handle whose view models to query.

elements.name: rive.cmd.requestArtboardNames
elements.description: Requests artboard names for the file.

parameters.name: file_handle
parameters.doc: File handle whose artboards to query.

elements.name: rive.cmd.requestViewModelInstanceViewModelName
elements.description: Requests the view model name used by the view model instance.

parameters.name: instance_handle
parameters.doc: View model instance handle to query.

elements.name: rive.cmd.requestViewModelEnums
elements.description: Requests enum definitions for the file.

parameters.name: file_handle
parameters.doc: File handle whose enums to query.

elements.name: rive.cmd.requestViewModelPropertyDefinitions
elements.description: Requests property definitions for the view model.

parameters.name: file_handle
parameters.doc: File handle whose view models to query.

parameters.name: viewmodel_name
parameters.doc: View model name whose property metadata to request.

elements.name: rive.cmd.requestViewModelInstanceNames
elements.description: Requests instance names for the view model.

parameters.name: file_handle
parameters.doc: File handle whose view models to query.

elements.name: rive.cmd.requestViewModelInstanceBool
elements.description: Requests the boolean value for the property.

elements.name: rive.cmd.requestViewModelInstanceNumber
elements.description: Requests the numeric value for the property.

elements.name: rive.cmd.requestViewModelInstanceColor
elements.description: Requests the color value for the property.

elements.name: rive.cmd.requestViewModelInstanceEnum
elements.description: Requests the enum value for the property.

elements.name: rive.cmd.requestViewModelInstanceString
elements.description: Requests the string value for the property.

elements.name: rive.cmd.requestViewModelInstanceListSize
elements.description: Requests the list size for the property.

elements.name: rive.cmd.requestViewModelInstanceListClear
elements.description: Clears all entries from the nested list at the path.

parameters.name: view_model_handle
parameters.doc: View model instance owning the list.

elements.name: rive.cmd.requestStateMachineNames
elements.description: Requests state machine names for the artboard.

elements.name: rive.cmd.requestDefaultViewModelInfo
elements.description: Requests metadata about the default view model or artboard.
